About Event

Welcome to SearchHack: Build the Next Layer of AI Search
AI has changed how people search, but most of what’s out there is still a search box with an LLM attached. We think the interesting work is a layer deeper, and we want to spend a day building it with you.
SearchHack is a one-day hackathon for engineers, researchers, and founders working on how information gets found, retrieved, routed, and remembered by AI systems.
Judges
Investment Director, Micron Ventures

Investment Lead, Llama Ventures

Investor, Foothill Ventures

Investment Lead, Sixty Degree Capital

More to come!

Prizes
1st place: iPhone 18 Pro + $1500 Telem AI credits + 30,000 Tavily credits

2nd place: Apple Watch Series 12 + $800 Telem AI credits + 20,000 Tavily credits

3rd place: AirPods 5 + $300 Telem AI credits + 10,000 Tavily credits

The problem
AI systems have too much information and not enough sense of what to do with it. Context gets fragmented, retrieval is expensive, personalization is weak, memory is limited, and routing across different sources is mostly guesswork. Keyword search doesn’t solve this, and neither does putting a chatbot on top of it.
What to build
Anything that makes AI search meaningfully better. Some directions we’d love to see:
Retrieval that goes beyond keyword matching

Long-context and memory systems

Routing queries to the right engine, database, or tool

Agents that plan, search, verify, and synthesize across sources

Faster, cheaper retrieval with fewer wasted tokens

Knowledge graphs and connecting scattered information

Search that understands a user’s context and history

Search across images, video, audio, and code

New interfaces for working with information

You don’t have to stick to this list. If you have a better idea, build that.

About Diwali
Diwali, also known as the Festival of Lights, is one of the most celebrated festivals in India. It symbolizes the victory of light over darkness and good over evil. During Diwali, people decorate their homes with colorful lights, candles, and beautiful rangoli designs. Families celebrate by sharing sweets, exchanging gifts, wearing new clothes, and enjoying fireworks. It is a time of happiness, love, hope, and togetherness.

Tracks
🛡️ Security — Attack & Defend
Build AI agents that simulate cyberattacks and defend systems against potential threats in a controlled environment.
Red Agent identifies vulnerabilities, tests system defenses, and exposes security weaknesses. Blue Agent detects threats, analyzes vulnerabilities, and strengthens system security. The Red Agent shares its findings with the Blue Agent, which uses them to detect threats and improve system defenses.
Example: One agent attempts to breach a test application while the other detects the attack and recommends security fixes.
💹 Finance — Analyze & Trade
Build AI agents that research financial markets, identify investment opportunities, and make data-driven trading decisions. Analyst Agent gathers market data, tracks trends, and identifies potential investment opportunities. Trader Agent uses market insights to make decisions and execute simulated trades. The Analyst Agent shares market insights with the Trader Agent, which uses them to make informed trading decisions.
Example: One agent tracks stock trends and identifies opportunities while another executes simulated trades based on its analysis.
🎨 Marketing — Create & Copy
Build AI agents that work together to create complete marketing campaigns with engaging visuals and compelling content. Visual Agent generates campaign images, promotional creatives, and marketing videos. Copy Agent creates matching headlines, captions, ad copy, and social media content. The Visual Agent shares creative concepts with the Copy Agent, which turns them into matching marketing content.
Example: Give the agents a product description and get campaign visuals, social media posts, and matching ad copy.
📊 Research — Data & Build
Build AI agents that collect information, analyze data, and turn research into useful applications.
Data Agent searches the web, gathers live information, and organizes it into structured data. Builder Agent transforms the collected data into websites, dashboards, or interactive applications. The Data Agent passes its findings to the Builder Agent, which uses them to create functional, data-driven products.
Example: One agent collects live industry data while another turns it into an interactive research dashboard.

Can your robot finish the task? Can it recover from a failed attempt? Can you push your score higher before the deadline?

A voice-controlled assistant that asks for help when it gets stuck.

A robot workflow triggered by a calendar event or a message.

An interactive experience where people and robots solve something together.

A physical tool your software agent can call to get a real-world job done.

An opening setup workshop to help teams get started.

10 promising Nordic startups building in the Bay take center stage in front of investors, operators, and founders.

Residents from their founder residency have gone onto raise from a16z, Sequoia, Accel, Founders Fund, and more.

Moderated by: Vladimira Cincurova, CEO and Founder, European Startup Embassy: European Startup Embassy offers physical and virtual infrastructure for European startups and investors to thrive in the U.S, including a residency, access to US capital and practical mentorship. 🥤 Snacks and drinks on us

UC San Diego's Design and Innovation Building hosts Techstars Startup Weekend San Diego, bringing builders, designers, lawyers, and the legally curious together for a weekend focused squarely on legal tech, software, and innovation. The theme: reimagining law for the AI era. The legal industry touches nearly everyone and has changed less than almost any other sector in the last few decades. This weekend is about building the tools that could finally change that, from AI that helps a tenant fight an eviction to software that lets a small business draft a contract without a $400-an-hour phone call.
Around 100 participants will pitch ideas, form teams around the strongest ones, and spend the weekend building toward a final pitch to a panel of judges. Mentors and coaches work alongside teams throughout, helping them get out of the building to validate ideas with real users, sharpen product direction, and prepare a polished final pitch.
Julian Bryant , Lead Organizer of Techstars Startup Weekend San Diego and an attorney/software developer himself, has facilitated roughly 40 Startup Weekends and brings a track record of real companies launched from the format, including CreativeUp, a Santa Barbara-based company that formed at one of his earliest events and is still operating more than six years later.
Jacques Chirazi , Director of the Basement and Entrepreneurship Center at UC San Diego's Office of Innovation and Commercialization, brings UC San Diego's student entrepreneurship ecosystem into the weekend, connecting participants to campus resources that can carry momentum well past Sunday night.
